Timida studentă Penny Taylor respectă întotdeauna regulile. Cel puțin aşa li se pare colegilor ei de facultate. Tânăra însă are un secret murdar: s-a îndrăgostit până peste cap de profesorul ei. Și e destul de sigură că și reciproca e adevărată.

Toata lumea îl apreciază pe profesorul Hunter. Este înalt, brunet și chipeș. Și, desigur, inaccesibil. Ochii lui căprui profunzi ascund taine care o ademenesc pe

Penny. Taine mai întunecate decât și-ar putea imagina ea vreodată.

Cu un an în urmă, James Hunter a renunțat la viața de miliardar pe care o ducea la New York pentru a deveni profesor. Cea mai simplă regula pe care

trebuie să o urmeze e să nu se împrietenească prea tare cu studenții. O regulă care pare ușor de respectat pentru ca trăiește destul de retras în noul său oraș, iar

acesta e singurul mod în care știe cum să-și păstreze secretele doar pentru sine.

Totuși, profesorul Hunter nu s-a așteptat niciodată să-i predea unei studente atât de frumoase, căreia trebuie să-i reziste. Și de care trebuie să se îndepărteze.

Penny merită mai mult decât un bărbat care încă se luptă cu demonii săi. Însă ea îndrăzneşte să întreacă limita. Iar el nu a fost niciodată genul de bărbat care să reziste tentației.

This book gives new meaning to the phrase "Hot for teacher"

I was really torn with rating this book. Even while writing this review, I'm torn. I enjoyed this book and it proved to be a fast read. I have also read some of the later books in the series and finally got the chance to read the book which started the series. I can see where the Author has grown as a writer. For me this was fun, escapism reading.

Penny is a nineteen-year-old college student who bumps into a man in a coffee shop. Her coffee spills on her and he offers her his sweater to wear as an apology. She accepts while noticing how good looking the man is. What could have been an innocent encounter turns serious when she shows up for her first class and is shocked to see that the man who gave her his sweater is her professor, James Hunter. Lust and longing enter stage left...

They have instantaneous lust and longing for each other which is complicated by him being her professor and also because of a fellow student who wants to be more than friends with Penny as well. Both throw caution to the wind and enter into a relationship.

Forbidden romance full of angst, secrets, and false assumptions. Some of the characters are immature and I wanted to take and shake them. I wasn't a big fan of her roommate and at times, Penny's immaturity was annoying. At times, I wondered what a twenty-seven-year-old professor who once had his own company would see in her. Having read some of the later books, I can say that she does mature and shows growth in later books. Plus, he is her professor.... I kept thinking of all the legal, ethical and moral issues that would come into play of a professor becoming involved intimately/romantically with a student. I would imagine that all universities would frown down upon that and have strict rules/code of conduct guidelines. But then again, wasn't that the point? That their relationship is naughty and forbidden? That they are throwing caution to the wind and going for it, it is a forbidden romance after-all. I did enjoy learning how the Penny and James I met in latter books, met in this book. This is definitely not your mother's harlequin romance! There are some hot scenes so if you don't like sex scenes in your romance books this wont be for you. If you are willing to overlook the issues surrounding the forbidden romance, you might just enjoy these characters and their story.

So even with some of the issues I had with the book, I enjoyed it. It was a fast-steamy read.

A sexy New Adult forbidden romance.
"...You never know what you'll find during a long walk in the rain."
For anyone who has ever lusted after a professor.
For readers who crave passion and drama.
For smut-loving readers on a rainy day...

The Hunted series is written in an interesting format - It is planned out as a trilogy, and each of the three books are split into three parts.

If you enjoy reading serial series, you can read each of the nine parts as they're published, or if you're a fan of longer works (like me) you can read the bundled novels.


THE HUNTED: TEMPTATION - PART ONE

Off to a great Start!
This wasn't a game. Flirting with him wasn't the same as it was with guys my own age. Professor Hunter had an air of danger around him. He was intriguing because he terrified me.
I'm a sucker for sexy, broody professors, and Professor James Hunter is mouth-watering...

This installment represents the very start of our adventure with Penny and her whirlwind affair with her Communications Professor. The majority of the text laid the groundwork for the series - We get to know Penny (who has the sole, 1st person POV) as well as her friends and suitors.

Penny falls into the pseudo-tropey shy bookish college student category. She's not a virgin, but she's fairly inexperienced. Her previous romantic encounters have been pretty disastrous.

She's been dating boys.
Professor James Hunter is a Man.

Ah yes, forbidden fruit.

...I wasn't a bad girl, but I wanted to be bad for him. Doesn't that make me bad? I wanted to do things with him that would surely get him fired.
The story had a steady pace to it, and I was enjoying myself. The tension was building between Penny and Professor Hunter, and just when I though I would pass out from all the UST... The two had their moment.

AND. IT. WAS. HOT.
Sweet Baby Jesus, it was phenomenal!

I had already determined that the series was worth exploring, but once we hit that glorious moment of sexiness, I was hooked!


THE HUNTED: TEMPTATION - PART TWO

Delicious!
I wasn't just fucking my professor. I was in deep. I loved him. I'm in clove with my Comm professor.
I'd like to start by saying that this little story contains one the the most jaw-dropping first dates I've read in a while - It might just melt your Kindle, so beware of the hotness!

Penny and her Professor have given in to temptation - their illicit affair is in full swing. Penny's feelings for James Hunter are growing, but we're no closer to unraveling the mystery which surrounds the man.

This episode picked up right where part one left off. The couple's hot and heavy desk-top romp was supposed to be the only moment of weakness.

Yeah Right!
The Professor wants more,
Penny needs more,
and I can't help but crave more of them both!

Penny and her professor are doing a bit of dating in this installment of the series, which allows for glimpses into the mysterious Professor Hunter, but it also increases the tension a bit... Because their relationship must stay a secret.

There's the whole student/professor dynamic,
The inexperienced and naive/ heartthrob sex-god balance,
and a fairly sizable age gap... Speaking of which, Penny has allowed her professor to assume she's a senior, and two years older than she actually is...

We left off with a cliffhanger at the end of this story, so I'll be jumping right into the next book.

The odds are definitely stacked against this couple, so I'm eager to see how it all plays out!


THE HUNTED: TEMPTATION - PART THREE

Penny Taylor, step forward to receive your Hot Mess award...
Brownies were second only to condoms on my list of favorite things that come in foil.
A lot that went down in Part 3 of Temptation, so let's get going...

Penny left Professor Hunter's Apartment at the end of the last episode convinced that James Hunter is a married man. It was a thoughtless tantrum that makes me want to shake the crap out of this girl.

Penny Taylor has a habit of making childish & shortsighted decisions. She loudly proclaims the moral high-ground from deep within the hole she's digging herself.

In short, Penny Taylor is an obnoxious hot mess of a little girl... And for some unknown reason, I was glued to her story. Drama, drama, drama. I'm pretty sure I even yelled at my book a few times.



I'm a total sucker for the seduction of hot, brooding professors. That type of forbidden romance gets my smutty stamp of approval every single time.

The student/professor dynamic is plenty to work with in the angst department, but this story is determined to stack the odds against our MCs as high as humanly possible.

We've got a forbidden romance,
Obsessed professors,
Childish meltdowns,
Meddling friends,
& before this story concludes, we'll be laying in a good ol' fashioned love triangle.

HOT.
MESS.
...and I can't seem to look away.

I can't even fully articulate what has me so hypnotized by this overly angsty New Adult Romance. Penny Taylor is the kind of character that I want to rail against. She consistently makes wrong decisions. It's pretty impressive, actually.

Of course, it helps that Professor Hunter is a total heartthrob. Wealthy, mysterious, gorgeous, and utterly unobtainable. I can understand how a girl might lose her senses in the face of all that perfection.

The Hunted series might be a case of 'The Right Book at the Right Time'. I enjoyed the story despite the fact that it's outside of my usual tastes.

Ivy Smoak is a new to me author, and I'm enjoying what she has to offer.

Wtf! 🤯 Nicméně to, jak se k němu pak Penny zachovala a využila ho… FUJ!

To její oslovování „profesore Huntere“ ve chvílích, kdy spolu byli sami, bylo totálně cringe. Kdyby to řekla jednou v nějakém roztoužení nebo nevím, tak ok. Ale furt? Ne. 🙄

Je mu 27, ale už stihl vymyslet, rozjet a prodat technologickou firmu za nekřesťanské peníze, takže je teď nesmyslně bohatý. Tomu se v knihách vždycky směju. 😂 Ach jo. Byl by to takový problém dopřát tomu (povětšinou) chlapovi, aby tu firmu prodal poté, co ji třeba 20 let piplal? A ať je mu teda klidně 40. Což teda jasně, to se nehodí do studentského prostředí. Ale kdyby to byl chudý profesor, mělo by to daleko větší šťávu, protože by ten jejich sex (slovu láska se vyhnu, protože tady jde čistě o sex) byl opravdu zakázaný. „Ve hře je moje kariéra, Penny.“ Ne, není. 😂

Zhruba v půlce knihy mají u Huntera hlubokomyslnou debatu o důvěře. Penny řekne, že „má pocit, že před ní něco tají“. No jasně, že tajil! Vždyť jste spolu ještě pořádně nikdy nemluvili, absolutně nic o sobě nevědí! 😂

„Ukážu ti, že mi jde o víc než jen o sex.“ A čím jí to ukázal? Sexem. 😂

Penny najde jeden předmět doličný (ať zas nevyžvaním všechno), vytvoří si domněnku, nic mu neřekne a začne trucovat a chovat se jak malá. Nesnáším.

Ty narážky na jeho věk, dotaz, jestli nemá krizi středního věku, pak že se „vyspala se starším mužem“ nebo „Vám fakt nevadí ten věkový rozdíl?“ Jestli tam chtěla dát autorka age gap, tak měla dát 40letého profesora. Tomuhle je 27 a hrdinka má slavit 20. narozeniny! Vždyť je to výsměch. 😃

A ten konec?! 🤣 No tak to mám dost. 🤣

4,5 stelline
Penny aveva da poco iniziato il college e si trovava ancora nella fase di apprendimento del proprio corso di studi, cercando di tenere a bada le tante emozioni che invadevano la sua testa, per la novità di quell’ambito scolastico nel quale stava vivendo.
Era una brava ragazza, attenta osservatrice delle regole e per sua natura affatto trasgressiva, nel Campus difatti conduceva una vita abbastanza riservata.

Ma quando casualmente si era scontrata con quello che poi aveva scoperto essere il suo professore di comunicazione, si era trovata nella condizione di dover mettere in discussione alcuni dei princìpi nei quali aveva fermamente creduto fino a quel momento.
Il professor Hunter era oscuro e tenebroso, ma bello da mozzare il fiato. Era sicuramente un insegnante giovane, ma in ogni caso più grande di lei di alcuni anni.

A lezione la guardava con interesse e mostrava genuino coinvolgimento per i suoi interventi, anche se palesemente impacciati.
«Non volevo risultare noiosa. Volevo che il professor Hunter mi notasse. Fino a quel momento le mie risposte sembravano averlo invogliato a parlare con me. E le nostre conversazioni imbarazzate mi avevano fatto sentire viva».

Penny non si sentiva di essere un tipo di ragazza che potesse interessare a qualcuno. La colpa era sicuramente del suo ex Austin e di tutte le volte che, quando stavano insieme, l’aveva fatta sentire insignificante.
Ma il professor Hunter la pensava diversamente.
Lei lo intrigava, le piaceva, e provava una potente attrazione che non riusciva a controllare: «Ti piace stuzzicarmi e non hai paura di dire ciò che pensi. E ti trovo incredibilmente provocante».

Il suo fisico perfetto e le sue parole ammalianti avevano il potere di cancellare tutte le inibizioni di Penny. Lui era misterioso e proibito. Sbagliato, ma così giusto, ed era la prima persona che l’aveva fatta sentire desiderata, come se fosse l’unica ragazza presente in aula durante le sue lezioni.
Quando era in sua compagnia si sentiva viva: «Era la cosa migliore che mi fosse mai capitata».

Un Forbidden romance ambientato nel college, che racconta di un amore proibito tra un insegnante e la sua giovane studentessa.
La caratterizzazione del personaggio di Penny risulta essere ben delineata. È sicuramente una ragazza con non molta esperienza, ma è disinibita, sfacciata e provocatrice nei confronti dell’uomo che ha fatto breccia nel suo cuore in poco tempo.

Lo sogna e lo desidera con ardore, e non fa nulla per nascondere i propri sentimenti, arrivando persino a mentirgli pur di averlo per sé.
«Non voglio che ti regoli professor Hunter. Mi piace che tu abbia un’influenza negativa su di me. Penso che sia proprio ciò di cui ho bisogno».

Finisce col sospeso e sinceramente non vedo l’ora di leggere il sequel perché Non tentarmi mi è proprio piaciuto.

Penny Taylor, step forward to receive your Hot Mess award...
Brownies were second only to condoms on my list of favorite things that come in foil.
A lot that went down in Part 3 of Temptation, so let's get going...

Penny left Professor Hunter's Apartment at the end of the last episode convinced that James Hunter is a married man. It was a thoughtless tantrum that makes me want to shake the crap out of this girl.

Penny Taylor has a habit of making childish & shortsighted decisions. She loudly proclaims the moral high-ground from deep within the hole she's digging herself.

In short, Penny Taylor is an obnoxious hot mess of a little girl... And for some unknown reason, I was glued to her story. Drama, drama, drama. I'm pretty sure I even yelled at my book a few times.



I'm a total sucker for the seduction of hot, brooding professors. That type of forbidden romance gets my smutty stamp of approval every single time.

The student/professor dynamic is plenty to work with in the angst department, but this story is determined to stack the odds against our MCs as high as humanly possible.

We've got a forbidden romance,
Obsessed professors,
Childish meltdowns,
Meddling friends,
& before this story concludes, we'll be laying in a good ol' fashioned love triangle.

HOT.
MESS.
...and I can't seem to look away.

I can't even fully articulate what has me so hypnotized by this overly angsty New Adult Romance. Penny Taylor is the kind of character that I want to rail against. She consistently makes wrong decisions. It's pretty impressive, actually.

Of course, it helps that Professor Hunter is a total heartthrob. Wealthy, mysterious, gorgeous, and utterly unobtainable. I can understand how a girl might lose her senses in the face of all that perfection.

The Hunted series might be a case of 'The Right Book at the Right Time'. I enjoyed the story despite the fact that it's outside of my usual tastes.
